name: tft128_gc9a01_7pin
title: Round 1.28-inch TFT on a GC9A01, seven contacts
description: A round 240x240 colour display on SPI, on a round board with seven contacts: no line for the backlight, which is always on
notes: The back says that R8 pulls CS down and that the module may be left without CS and RST. U3, a SOT-23, is not identified.

front.source: a photo by Anton of his module, 2026-11-13

back.source: a photo by Anton of his module, 2026-11-13

photo.source: a photo by Anton of his module, 2026-11-13
photo.notes: RST CS DC SDA SCL GND VCC on the front, VCC on a square pad; SPI beside the header on the back.

silkscreen.source: the back: 1.28"TFT VER1.0, 240*240, IC:GC9A01; the size in mm is a square of 1.28 inches across, not measured. Not tried.

levels.source: VCC is taken as the 3.3 V of the panel; what U3 does is not known. The start is what the GC9A01 driver starts with, not tried.
